competitors.description:
A lot is happening on @kamino  

→Institutional rails 
→Consumer yield 
→Open security 
→Developer distribution 

Let's take a look

•Atlas Collateral Management with Anchorage Digital

Kamino is piloting @Anchorage Atlas Collateral Management, a 24/7 automated system for institutional credit with real-time monitoring, automated margin calls, and liquidation infrastructure inside a regulated custody environment. 

In plain terms: institutions can now participate in Kamino's onchain credit markets without moving their assets out of regulated custody. The collateral stays where it is. The loan happens onchain. Atlas watches it round the clock.

•Marinade USDC Vault is live

@Marinade launched a USDC yield vault built on Kamino and managed by @Rockaway_X targeting up to 6% APY. RockawayX runs a conservative strategy across Kamino's main markets, Maple institutional credit, and RWA markets. 

What makes this worth noting: Marinade sees roughly 767,000 SOL in monthly unstakes, with 75% of users looking to convert to USD. That process used to cost 1 to 2% in fees across multiple steps. 

Now it's one click. Unstake, convert, start earning. The Kamino BuildKit is what made this possible without Marinade building credit infrastructure from scratch.

Details: https://t.co/4mplQakFcd

•$1.5M bug bounty with Immunefi

@kamino has had 18 audits and zero bad debt since launch. That track record makes it one of the most trusted protocols on Solana. 

A protocol that has already done the work to get to zero bad debt over three years doesn't launch a $1.5M bug bounty because they have to. They do it because the stakes are high enough that open security is the only responsible position. 

Every vulnerability disclosed before it becomes an exploit protects the people using the protocol.

Details: https://t.co/FIHTeGEPp7

•Eitherway integrates Kamino credit markets

@EitherwayAI an app builder for Solana, has integrated Kamino's credit markets. Builders get embedded lending, leverage, and yield out of the box. 

Every app that ships on Eitherway using credit is running on Kamino's stack without having to build it themselves.
